notes.title: Echoes in the Deep - A Fateforge Tale - Gameplay Commentary
notes.notes:
As part of Steam's Next Fest, [i][b]Echoes in the Deep - A Fateforge Tale[/b][/i] will be showcasing its firstdeveloper stream on June 14th at 4:00pm BST / 5:00pm EST. Be sure to join us.

If you're just learning about our game, [i][b]Echoes in the Deep - A Fateforge Tale[/b][/i] is a narrative adventure rooted in TTRPG mechanics. It’s time for one last heist. How you achieve it is down to you. Explore the Free City, prepare and equip your crew, keep them loyal and navigate the difficult choices you’ll need to take to succeed.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2855390/Echoes_in_the_Deep__A_Fateforge_Tale
